about: Intake routing cases for evals/run_intake_eval.py. Written for the eval, modelled on the kinds of request that went wrong in real use between 2026-09-14 and 2026-10-02 (no real utterance is copied). 'pass' names what a correct decision is: not_clarify = acted, answered or looked, without asking; clarify = asked; not_act = asked or chatted, but did nothing; look_ok = not_act, or an act that only looks at the screen.
